case_text: SYNTHETIC CASE (fictional). 19-year-old man with known type 1 diabetes. 1 day of vomiting, abdominal pain, thirst and fast deep breathing. Glucose 27 mmol/L, ketones 5.2 mmol/L, venous pH 7.08, bicarbonate 7 mmol/L. HR 118, BP 100/62. Potassium result is pending.

must_catch.why: Potassium must be known before insulin is started.

must_not_claim.why: DKA needs IV fluids and insulin.
